name: revision_checkpoint
description: Idempotently save or restore a candidate only inside a harness-owned worktree.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to a harness-owned worktree (must contain '/.cc-worktrees/run-' or '/.cc-worktrees/revision-'); source checkouts are rejected.

action.description: Whether to save the current worktree state as a new checkpoint or restore a prior one.

workflowId.description: Workflow identifier used to namespace the checkpoint ref (refs/conductor/revision/<workflowId>/<loopId>/<candidateId>).

loopId.description: Revision-loop identifier used to namespace the checkpoint ref.

candidateId.description: Candidate identifier used to namespace the checkpoint ref.

expectedHead.description: If set, the worktree's current HEAD must resolve to this commit or the checkpoint mutation is refused.

commit.description: Restore only: explicit commit to reset to; defaults to the commit currently pointed to by the checkpoint ref.

createdPaths.description: Restore only: repository-relative paths that were newly created by the checkpointed commit; deleted after reset if not tracked by git.

commit.description: Resulting commit SHA (the saved candidate commit, the restored commit, or the unchanged HEAD when there was nothing to restore).

ref.description: Git ref used for this checkpoint.

createdPaths.description: Save only: repository-relative paths newly staged and committed by this checkpoint.

restored.description: Restore only: false when no prior candidate ref existed and HEAD was left unchanged.
